items.defectStatement: MetricAlertDetectorHandler inherits four abstract members from StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none, so accessing Detector.detector_handler for metric_alert_fire raises TypeError. This breaks the previously instantiable placeholder handler.
obligations: Allow MetricAlertDetectorHandler to be instantiated with a Detector.
Preserve placeholder evaluation behavior without producing occurrences or changing detector state.
Return an empty mapping from evaluate, as required by the current detector processing contract.
items.notes: The frozen input omits the current mapping return contract and abstract method signatures; restoring the old list return would fail at process_detectors' .values() call. Imports can be included within the replacement, making the behavioral fix local. Removing the now-unused StatefulDetectorHandler import is separate cleanup.
